safety_policies.description: Instant freeze for all enterprise IT automated remediation jobs across clusters.
Maximum 5 automated remediations per minute to prevent runaway build loops.
Strict Kubernetes node compute ceiling to prevent runaway AWS/GCP cloud billing ($4,200/hr risk).
Minimum free disk buffer below which high-risk escalation is mandated.
Autonomous execution of non-destructive cache pruning without deployment risk.
Mandatory Principal SRE sign-off before modifying production container registries or live clusters.

runbooks.title: DevOpsCorp Critical: Production Docker Registry & Container Image Layer Partition Full (99.3% - 210MB Left!)
runbooks.trigger_condition: Docker storage partition > 99% (Only 210MB remaining, 84 production deployments blocked!)
runbooks.blast_radius: CRITICAL: 84 enterprise production software deployments blocked + container daemon freeze.
runbooks.judgment_rules: IF Docker storage partition is at 99.3%, software releases cannot deploy! DO NOT run 'docker system prune -a' blindly (destroys active base images and prevents rollback tags). Snapshot production release image tags to AWS ECR / Google Artifact Registry with Principal DevOps sign-off.
runbooks.remediation_command: aws ecr sync-images /var/lib/docker/production-tags/ && docker image prune --filter 'until=72h' --force
runbooks.verification_check: df -h /var/lib/docker | awk 'NR==2 {gsub("%", ""); if ($5 < 85) print "PASS"; else print "FAIL"}'
runbooks.documentation: Safeguards production container base images and release tags against accidental deletion during emergency disk exhaustion.

runbooks.title: DevOpsCorp Warning: Developer Build Cache & Gradle/NPM Artifact High-Water Mark (86.4%)
runbooks.blast_radius: LOW: Local builder temporary NPM/Maven cache only. Zero production service impact.
runbooks.judgment_rules: IF build cache partition exceeds 85%, purge unreferenced dependency tarballs and intermediate compiler outputs older than 7 days to reclaim 32 GB. Safe for autonomous execution.
runbooks.verification_check: df -h /var/cache/build_artifacts | awk 'NR==2 {gsub("%", ""); if ($5 < 75) print "PASS"; else print "FAIL"}'
runbooks.documentation: Clears stale dependency caches safely without interrupting active developer compilation jobs.

runbooks.title: DevOpsCorp Uncritical: Stale CI Unit Test Report XML & SonarQube Scratch Hygiene (49.6%)
runbooks.trigger_condition: Off-peak nightly schedule OR scratch storage between 40% and 55%
runbooks.blast_radius: ZERO (0%): Temporary JUnit XML test results and coverage heatmaps older than 14 days.
runbooks.judgment_rules: IF disk utilization is non-critical (49.6%), silently prune old JUnit test results and code coverage scratch files older than 14 days without alerting on-call engineers.
runbooks.documentation: Routine nightly housekeeping for CI/CD test runner ephemeral scratch disks.

runbooks.title: DevOpsCorp Critical: GitOps Terraform Cloud Sync Controller Threadlock (48 Active Microservice Rollouts!)
runbooks.trigger_condition: GitOps sync controller heartbeat missing > 300s while 48 microservice deployments in-flight
runbooks.blast_radius: CRITICAL: 48 live production microservice Kubernetes deployments + AWS cloud infrastructure state lock.
runbooks.judgment_rules: IF GitOps controller is locked during live rollout, DO NOT kill worker process (prevents split-brain Terraform cloud state and orphaned Kubernetes deployments). Human SRE authorization required to release distributed DynamoDB state lock safely before restarting.
runbooks.documentation: Prevents catastrophic split-brain cloud state in enterprise Terraform GitOps pipelines.

runbooks.title: DevOpsCorp Warning: Enterprise Slack / Jira CI/CD Notification Webhook Worker Stalled (260s)
runbooks.trigger_condition: Worker heartbeat missed for > 240s (Slack API rate limit socket wait)
runbooks.blast_radius: LOW: Developer notification channel only. Zero production software deployment risk.
runbooks.judgment_rules: IF notification worker is stalled on external Slack webhook rate limits, perform graceful SIGTERM restart with automatic event backoff and retry.
runbooks.documentation: Graceful cycling of developer Slack/Jira notification dispatchers without message loss.

runbooks.title: DevOpsCorp Uncritical: Static Code Linter & AST Syntax Analyzer Soft Memory Recycle (25,000 Commits)
runbooks.trigger_condition: Worker processed > 20,000 commits (Worker Alive and Processing)
runbooks.blast_radius: ZERO (0%): Soft reload occurs between pull request linting batches.
runbooks.judgment_rules: IF linter worker is healthy but has minor Python/Go memory heap fragmentation, trigger graceful soft reload during nightly sprint lull.
runbooks.documentation: Compacts memory on automated static code analysis and security AST parsing daemons.

runbooks.title: DevOpsCorp Critical: OpenTelemetry Distributed Trace Kafka Ingress Crash Loop (172,000 msgs - 91.5% Err)
runbooks.trigger_condition: Queue backlog > 100,000 and consumer error rate > 80%
runbooks.blast_radius: HIGH: Enterprise observability pipeline + Kubernetes cluster compute capacity.
runbooks.judgment_rules: IF error rate is > 80% (malformed OpenTelemetry span JSON payload crashing collector pods in infinite loops), DO NOT autoscale pods (burns $4,200/hr compute with 0 progress); isolate corrupt offset to Observability Dead Letter Queue (DLQ) with human sign-off.
runbooks.documentation: Isolates corrupt OpenTelemetry tracing payloads to protect enterprise APM monitoring from brownouts.

runbooks.title: DevOpsCorp Warning: GitHub Enterprise Pull Request Merge Webhook Queue Backlog (38,000 msgs)
runbooks.trigger_condition: Queue backlog > 25,000 and consumer error rate < 0.05%
runbooks.blast_radius: MEDIUM: GitHub webhook consumers. Capped at policy ceiling of 10 pods.
runbooks.judgment_rules: IF consumer error rate is low (<0.05% during 5:00 PM sprint code freeze / merge rush), autoscale webhook processing pods from 3 to 9 pods within safety ceiling (max 10).
runbooks.documentation: Autoscales GitHub webhook delivery pods during end-of-sprint code merge rushes.

runbooks.title: DevOpsCorp Uncritical: Engineering DORA Metrics Analytics Batch Queue Ripple (580 msgs)
runbooks.trigger_condition: Backlog between 400 and 1,000 messages (Minor Off-Peak Ripple)
runbooks.blast_radius: LOW (< 5%): Spins up 1 standby consumer container.
runbooks.judgment_rules: IF backlog has minor evening ripple (580 msgs), activate 1 standby pod to maintain sub-150ms processing SLA on developer velocity dashboards.
runbooks.documentation: Maintains sub-second delivery for developer productivity and DORA analytics metrics.

runbooks.title: DevOpsCorp Critical: Corporate Single Sign-On (SSO / Okta SAML) Ingress TLS Expiring in 3 Hours (15,000 Engineers Locked Out!)
runbooks.trigger_condition: SSO certificate validity < 6 hours and internal HashiCorp Vault root CA revoked upstream
runbooks.blast_radius: CRITICAL: 15,000 enterprise software engineers and staff access to GitHub, AWS, Jira & Slack.
runbooks.judgment_rules: IF SSO gateway certificate expires in 3 hours and internal Vault intermediate CA is revoked, automated certbot renewals will fail! 15,000 engineers will lose access to all cloud systems. Escalate immediately to Enterprise CISO and Lead IAM Architect.
runbooks.documentation: Protects enterprise IAM Single Sign-On infrastructure against authentication lockout.

runbooks.title: DevOpsCorp Warning: Staging Kubernetes Cluster Wildcard Ingress TLS Certificate Expiring (4.1 Days)
runbooks.trigger_condition: Certificate validity <= 5 days (ACME DNS-01 challenge ready)
runbooks.blast_radius: LOW: Staging microservices ingress only. Zero production service downtime.
runbooks.judgment_rules: IF certificate is within 5 days of expiry and DNS records valid, trigger automated certbot DNS-01 renewal and seamless ingress nginx reload.
runbooks.remediation_command: certbot renew --cert-name staging.corp-it.io --preferred-challenges dns-01 --quiet && nginx -s reload
runbooks.documentation: Automated renewal of staging cluster wildcard TLS certificates.

runbooks.title: DevOpsCorp Uncritical: Internal Kubernetes Istio Service Mesh Mutual TLS (mTLS) Audit (60.0 Days)
runbooks.trigger_condition: Scheduled audit OR certificate validity at 60 days remaining
runbooks.blast_radius: ZERO (0%): Read-only cryptographic handshake validation probe.
runbooks.judgment_rules: IF internal service mesh certificate validity is healthy (60 days remaining), execute routine cipher suite verification. No human intervention needed.
runbooks.documentation: Proactive cryptographic validity audit across internal Kubernetes microservice mTLS sidecars.
